BiblicalUsage: Yârôwq is the green thing, every green herb the wild ass searches for on the mountains. Job hears God ask who provides for the wild ass, whose pasture is the range of the mountains and every green thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds the wild ass on the mountains, and the green things are His provision for creatures men forget.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
